title: Agglomerate
summary: AGGLOM'ERATE, verb transitive [Latin agglomero, ad and glomero, to wind into a ball, from glomus a ball of yarn; from the Heb. to involve.] To wind, or collect into a ball; to gather into a mass. AGGL

inlines.v: AGGLOM'ERATE, verb transitive [Latin agglomero, ad and glomero, to wind into a ball, from glomus a ball of yarn; from the Heb. to involve.] To wind, or collect into a ball; to gather into a mass. AGGLOM'ERATE, verb intransitive To gather, grow or collect into a ball or mass.
